title: Understanding Sampling Bias
text: Consider how the method of inviting students might influence who chooses to respond. Are there any groups of students who might be more likely to participate than others?

title: Target Population vs. Sample
text: Think about the difference between the entire group of UC Berkeley students and those who actually take the survey. What factors could cause these two groups to differ?

title: Evaluating Representativeness
text: Which of the following factors could affect whether the survey respondents are representative of the entire student body?
choices: The time the survey is sent out
